title: murraya microphylla
intro: Murraya microphylla, commonly known as May Chang or Chinese boxwood, is a small, evergreen tree native to China. The plant is valued for its leaves, which are used in traditional medicine due to their health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Murraya microphylla include reducing stress and anxiety, improving sleep quality, and acting as an antiseptic and antiviral agent. The bioactive constituents of the plant include limonene, beta-pinene, and alpha-pinene, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
